newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-BETIS AND CELTA THROUGH TO SPANISH CUP SEMIFINALS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BETIS AND CELTA THROUGH TO SPANISH CUP SEMIFINALS.

text.p: Real Betis and Celta Vigo will join Barcelona and second-division Las Palmas in the Spanish Cup semifinals after ensuring comfortable aggregate wins in quarter-final second legs on Thursday.
Betis beat struggling Rayo Vallecano 2-1 to take a 4-1 aggregate victory, while Celta added a 1-0 win to their 2-1 first leg win at Racing Santander.
Las Palmas had scraped past Espanyol on the away goals rule on Wednesday night, while Barcelona launched an epic fight-back to turn a 3-0 half-time deficit into a 5-4 victory over Atletico Madrid.
Barcelona and Betis, second and third in the league respectively, are the hot favourites for the Cup ahead of Friday's lunchtime semifinal draw.
